name: quox-nucleus

description: Codebase intelligence for your agents. They answer with file:line citations from actual indexed source code. CogCore3D nucleus becomes a live galaxy of your codebase. Code search, cross-repo queries, and import graph visualisation.

author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Agents cite actual code with file:line references
Natural language code search across 12+ repos
CogCore3D nucleus shows live codebase structure
3D force-directed graph of 5,000+ files and 11,000+ connections
